dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A remarkable land indeed... breeding such "masterminds."

dialogues.speaker: Dozorov
dialogues.text: Aye, the fishermen living along these shores are all warriors who battle the sea... Don't underestimate the grit we forge amidst the icy waters and giant waves!

dialogues.speaker: Dozorov
dialogues.text: *sigh*... If this miserable arthritis of mine weren't acting up so much, I'd still be out there braving the waves with those young lads. A shame... a real shame...
